source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.

morphology_documented.habit: Trailing low arching bramble; canes root at tips, leaves semi-evergreen
morphology_documented.leaves: Leaflets glabrous below or hairs mainly along primary veins; margins without glands
morphology_documented.flowers: Usually 1–3 flowers per lateral branchlet, petals 15–25 mm

source_scope_note: Historical rank and source scope retained; genus, species, variety and comparator traits not conflated.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: Historic 1997 state list omits taxon; do not confuse with Pursh homonym
preservation: Additive research only; original species, images, credits and galleries untouched
